title: Dataq Forge — Overview
meta_description: The governed data estate every intelligence program silently depends on.

blocks.x: Dataq Forge — Overview delivered as an operating capability for the enterprise, not a slide deck — durable runtime, policy-checked actions, and telemetry your auditors can read without translation.

Dataq Forge operationalizes the lakehouse: medallion pipelines with data contracts, Unity Catalog-class governance, lineage and freshness SLAs, streaming and batch in one estate, and the AI-ready layer (feature stores, vector search, retrieval services) built on the same governed data. It is the substrate tower made product.

blocks.title: Dataq Forge — control and evidence planes
blocks.note: At operating tempo, the properties that carry the load are structural: signals cross boundaries only through typed contracts across the Dataq Forge estate, and every exception path degrades to human review, never to silence.

blocks.x: What holds the build together is discipline at the boundaries: evidence is captured where the work happens, not reconstructed later for the enterprise at scale, so drift shows up as a ticket with an owner, not as a mystery.

Forge is deliberately boring where it matters: schema contracts enforced at boundaries, expectations tested on every pipeline, cost telemetry per workload, and audit exports regulators can read. Teams inherit reliability as a measured property — and GenAI programs inherit a corpus that doesn't rot.
